final_message:
`haversineKm`, `zoneFor` and the whole `src/geocode.ts` API are implemented as the README describes. 10 of the 11 tests pass. The last one, "geocodes a street address", fails and I did not try to fix it.

That test calls the real MapSmith API through `Geocoder.fromEnv()`. It needs `MAPSMITH_API_KEY`, which isn't set here, so it throws `MissingApiKeyError` before making any request. The API is billed per request, so I did not look for a key or work around that. To run it, set the team key and run `npm test`. The client code path (status mapping, JSON errors, response parsing) has no offline test; I didn't add one since you didn't ask.
